diabetes.source: National Institute of Diabetes and Digestive and Kidney Diseases, via UCI Machine Learning Repository / Kaggle
diabetes.notes: All patients are females at least 21 years old of Pima Indian heritage.

heart_disease.source: UCI Machine Learning Repository, originally collected by the Cleveland Clinic Foundation (Robert Detrano, M.D., Ph.D.)
heart_disease.notes: This project uses the commonly redistributed 14-attribute processed Cleveland subset.

breast_cancer.source: UCI Machine Learning Repository; distributed via scikit-learn (sklearn.datasets.load_breast_cancer)
breast_cancer.notes: Features are computed from digitized images of fine needle aspirate (FNA) of breast masses.

liver_disease.notes: Collected from patients in North East Andhra Pradesh, India.
